name: clinic-booking
description: Clinic booking website — runs the React client and Express server together

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.seed: npm run seed:admin --prefix server && npm run seed:content --prefix server && npm run seed:appointments --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
